Package datautil

Class CSVController

  • java.lang.Object
    • datautil.CSVController
  • public class CSVController
extends java.lang.Object
    The CSVController class provides some simple methods for CSV input or output. Title : CSVController.java

    Description:

    The CSVController class provides some simple methods for CSV input or output.

    The most important feature of this class is that it can allow any class which has no sub object.

    Version:
    1.3
    Author:
    Tianyi Liu
